title: Mineral Dealer's Trading License (Class A)
issuer: State Department for Mining, Ministry of Mining, Blue Economy and Maritime Affairs
description: Statutory license authorizing the purchase, sale, assaying, refining, and export of precious metals under the Mining Act of Kenya.

title: Certificate of Incorporation & CR12 Register
issuer: Business Registration Service (BRS), Attorney General's Chambers
description: Official company incorporation registry and verified list of authorized directors and beneficial ownership.

title: Tax Compliance Certificate (TCC)
description: Proof of full corporate income tax, withholding tax, and mineral royalty compliance under Kenyan revenue statutes.

title: Agrément d'Achat et Commercialisation d'Or
issuer: Ministère des Mines / Division Provinciale des Mines, République Démocratique du Congo
description: Official comptoir permit authorizing purchasing, testing, weighing, and legal transport of mineral substances from registered artisanal cooperatives.

title: Mineral Dealer Registration & Commercial Permit
issuer: Ministry of Mining, Republic of South Sudan (Juba)
description: Registered mineral dealing permit under the Mining Act of South Sudan, allowing bullion trading, custody, and certified transport.

title: Certified Laboratory Assay Certificate (XRF & Fire Assay)
issuer: State Mining Laboratories & Independent ISO/IEC 17025 Accredited Laboratory
description: Comprehensive metallurgical test certificate stating fine gold content, density, and trace element spectrometry breakdown.

title: Specimen Mineral Export Customs Declaration & Permit
issuer: Kenya Customs & Border Control / Mining Cadastre Office
description: Illustrative export documentation demonstrating full mineral royalties settlement, customs clearance seal, and air cargo security manifest.
